topicName: Cloud-Native ELT (Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, dbt)
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Cloud-Native ELT Architecture with Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, and dbt"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Modern data stacks have shifted from traditional ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) to ELT (Extract, Load, Transform). By leveraging cloud-native data warehouses like Snowflake, Google BigQuery, and AWS Redshift, combined with dbt (data build tool), data engineers can load raw data immediately and perform transformations inside the data warehouse using SQL."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Setup"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A cloud data warehouse instance (Snowflake, BigQuery, or AWS Redshift)."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Python 3.8+ and dbt installed in your local environment."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Raw data loaded into your cloud storage and staged in the warehouse."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuring the dbt Profile"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"The profiles.yml file tells dbt how to connect to your chosen cloud data warehouse. Below is an example configuration for Snowflake."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"my_snowflake_project:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: snowflake
      account: your_account
      user: your_username
      password: your_password
      role: transforming_role
      database: raw_db
      warehouse: compute_wh
      schema: analytics
      threads: 4"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Writing Your First Transformation Model"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"In dbt, models are simply select statements. Create a file named 'stg_customers.sql' in your models directory to clean up raw customer data."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"with source as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_data', 'customers') }}
),

cleaned as (
    select
        id as customer_id,
        initcap(name) as customer_name,
        email,
        updated_at
    from source
)

select * from cleaned"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Running and Testing the ELT Pipeline"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once your models are defined, execute them using the dbt CLI command to materialize them as tables or views in your cloud data warehouse."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"dbt run --model stg_customers"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Finally, ensure data quality by running your configured tests to check for nulls or uniqueness constraints."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"dbt test"}]
